summary: Iter41 FINAL pricing overhaul + NEW P0 Regulator Pipeline Automation fully tested. BACKEND 27/27 PASS: /api/billing/tiers returns 40 tiers with correct Iter41 amounts (sole_trader 7990/799, enterprise 39990/3999, retail_single 9990, retail_enterprise 49990, hosp_single 14990, hosp_enterprise 69990, trans_owner 14990, health_enterprise 179990/17999). Annual savings 2×monthly verified for all 3 raised industries (trades [1598,3198,4998,7998], retail [1998,3998,5998,9998], hospitality [2998,5998,8998,13998]). Plan right-sizer all 5 scenarios correct: trades/1/1→7990+'6.9%' (no stale 5.1%/3.4%), hospitality/3/2→29990 (Small Group), retail/30/6→29990, healthcare/40/4→179990, transport/20/3→42990. Regulator pipeline end-to-end verified: /matrices exposes SIRS+NDIS+NHVR with triggers, POST /triage healthcare death → ≥2 matches (SIRS Priority 1 + NDIS Immediate, both 24h deadline), transport rollover → NHVR Immediate with written_report_deadline_at, trades minor cut → 0 matches + requires_regulator_notification=false, unknown industry → 200 empty graceful. POST /draft healthcare death creates case status=draft with UUID id, trades unmatched → 400. GET /pending returns case with earliest_deadline_at + hours_remaining ~24 + overdue=false. POST /mark-submitted/{id} transitions case to submitted + removes from pending. Non-existent case → 404. All endpoints auth-gated (401/403 unauthenticated). Regression: /scheduling/mandatory-credentials, /demo-requests, /regulatory-digest, /compliance-inbox all 200. FRONTEND: /pricing — all 5 industry tabs show correct prices (trades 7990/39990, hospitality 14990/69990, transport 14990/69990, healthcare 24990/179990, retail 9990/49990) + all 12 save-badge amounts match 2×monthly diff. Homepage entry-card prices 7990/9990/14990/14990/24990 correct + '6.9%' anchor present (no stale 5.1%/3.4%). /enterprise default shows trades A$3,999/A$39,990 + healthcare A$17,999/A$179,990 + '34.2%' anchor (no stale 25.6%). /franchises shows A$229/A$199/A$169 tiles + A$22,900/mo + A$274,800/yr correct. /partners Partner subscription fee A$2,999/mo correct. /credential-expiry-calculator trades A$7,990 + retail A$9,990 correct. /insurance-discount-calculator trades A$7,990 + hospitality A$14,990 correct. /seo/haccp-compliance Single Venue A$14,990/year + roiAnchor 'A$2,000 to A$4,000 per month' correct (no stale 11,990 / A$400-A$700). Sidebar 'Regulator Cases' link present with data-testid=nav-regulator-cases (1 match). /dashboard/regulator-cases renders with triage form; healthcare+death+description → shows BOTH SIRS and NDIS match cards with 24h deadline text visible. MINOR ISSUES: (1) /partners ROI calculator example copy still uses stale 'A$2,499/mo' in 2 places ('10 clients × A$2,499/mo × 15%' and '50 clients ... avg A$2,499/mo') — subscription fee itself is correctly A$2,999 but illustrative ROI numbers were not bumped. (2) /seo/haccp-compliance only shows Single Venue (A$14,990); the Multi-Venue A$44,990 plan from review request was not found rendered on the page — spec said 'Plans [Single Venue 14990, Multi-Venue 44990]' but only Single Venue is surfaced. (3) /dashboard RegulatorPipelineWidget with data-testid='regulator-widget' not detected after triage — either UI create-case button path did not complete successfully in the automated run, or widget rendering needs verification with a case present. Backend pending/draft endpoints are healthy so this is a UI-glue check. (4) /enterprise page: only Trades (default) + Healthcare amounts found in single pass; retail/transport/hospitality enterprise-tier amounts (A$4,999/A$49,990, A$6,999/A$69,990) may be behind industry tabs I could not locate via tested selectors — main agent should confirm if /enterprise has industry tabs or shows all 5 concurrently.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/regulator_pipeline.py is clean: uses datetime.now(timezone.utc), UUID4 case ids, account-scoped via stamp_account_fn + $set+query, MongoDB _id excluded via projection={_id:0} and doc.pop, auth-gated via Depends(get_current_user_dep), 400 for unmatched-keyword draft, 404 for cross-account mark-submitted (via update_one matched_count==0).

Keyword matching is case-insensitive substring (.lower()) — works for current corpus but 'death' will also match 'deathless' etc (low risk in domain terms). Word-boundary regex would be safer long-term.
SIRS + NDIS can BOTH trigger for same healthcare event — correctly modelled as independent match entries so the triage returns multiple pipelines, each with its own deadline clock.

billing.py BILLING_TIERS: 40 slugs with consistent format; Iter41 bumps hit trades/retail/hospitality; transport + healthcare unchanged as specified. Annual savings exactly 2×monthly for all raised tiers — arithmetic verified.
hours_remaining math in /pending rounds to 0.1h, fine for UI countdown; deadline parse uses isoformat with Z→+00:00 normalisation — handles both forms safely.
